settings.content: These values are owned by the Store Operating Standards. Changing one here changes it everywhere on the storefront at once, with no code deploy. Change the Standard first, then this. Never type one of these numbers into a page.

settings.label: Founding Member cap
settings.info: Store Operating Standards section 4. The number of founding slots, which does not reopen.

settings.label: Freshness window (days) - main shelves
settings.info: Store Operating Standards section 5. Days from roast date that coffee stays on Roccia, Sorpresa and Selezione. Past this it moves to Offerta. Windows may be SHORTENED but never extended - lengthening walks back a promise customers already bought under.

settings.label: Freshness window (days) - Offerta
settings.info: Store Operating Standards section 5. Absolute age ceiling. Offerta holds coffee from freshness_window_days + 1 up to this number of days from roast; past it, the coffee comes off sale entirely and is donated. Must be greater than freshness_window_days.

settings.label: Benefit grace period (days)
settings.info: Store Operating Standards section 4. How long subscriber and founder benefits continue after cancelling. NOT the freshness window - the two shared the value 60 until 2026-08-21, when freshness moved to 90 and this did not. That divergence is why they are separate settings.
